why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.1 draft, buffs and debuffs, system chat lines, the report lists unmatched system lines

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.1.498-beta (draft build 498) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

New
- Buffs and debuffs: the name, the description, the dispel type (Magic, Curse, Poison...) and the time left ('5 min remaining') of an aura tooltip are in Persian. It uses the same data, markers, colours and display choice as the spell page. New switch 'Buffs and debuffs in Persian' on the spell page, marked New.
- 66 aura names and 40 aura descriptions to start with: food and drink, Well Fed, stat buffs, crowd control (Stunned, Asleep, Hexed, Charmed...), the protection potions, poison and fire damage over time, speed changes.
- System chat lines: '[item] has been added to your appearance collection' (and removed), pets, mounts, toys, heirlooms, new titles and achievements, 'is sobering up' and the other drunk lines, friends and ignore, guild joins, leaves and ranks, duels, trade, auction, instance resets, ready check, away and busy.
- The report on the status page now also lists a system line nobody has translated yet (kind sys, links become %s) and a short aura text (kind tpl), so the next build adds exactly those.

Changed
- The social system lines (friends, guild, trade, duel, auction) follow the switch 'group changes'. Collection, title and achievement lines follow the 'reputation and skills' switch.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.

Everything from 1.2.0 is included.
